world.author: Narrative Engine test fixture
world.description: A small, unofficial Persona 3 setting sample for world-file import/export testing. Original summary text; no character identity, opening message, scripted events, or campaign progress.

chunks.content: Ordinary school life and supernatural exploration share the same setting. Students attend classes and build relationships by day, then confront Shadows during the Dark Hour.

chunks.header: Gekkoukan High School / 月光館学園
chunks.content: Gekkoukan High School is a hub for classes, clubs, and everyday student relationships. Use it for ordinary daytime scenes between supernatural expeditions.
Tartarus is a vast labyrinth encountered during the Dark Hour, the hidden interval between one day and the next. Exploration brings the group into conflict with Shadows.
The Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad, or S.E.E.S., investigates the Dark Hour and fights Shadows. This entry describes an organization; it does not create or assign a player character.
This entry exists only to verify that disabled lore remains disabled after sharing. It must not enter narrative retrieval.
